name: glute-kick-back.html
instructions:
1. Setup in a quadruped position with your hands underneath your shoulders, knees underneath your hips, and toes tucked.
2. While keeping a neutral spine and a 90 degree angle at the knee, extend the hip and drive the heel towards the ceiling.
3. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
